modules.name: NEXUSCLIP
modules.description: Clipper: drive and saturation into CLIP (seven curves), SPECTRAL or LIMIT at a hard ceiling, with a live transfer-curve screen

modules.name: RETICULUM
modules.description: Eight-node rete noise net with Lissajous scope, node matrix and drunk/walk/random modulation

modules.name: SEEDWALK
modules.description: Markov ball walking sixteen pinned rete nets with glided matrix interpolation; walk range, hold and per-net randomise

modules.name: EPOCH
modules.description: Long clock: a macro timeline of energy and silence that conducts the family over the BUS cable

modules.name: TURNAROUND
modules.description: Stereo phrase-end modulator: 4/8/16/32 bar turns, edit budget, rolls, wall and landing gap

modules.name: FLOATER
modules.description: A floater case: one clock, a rotating divider, eight Euclidean lanes with chance and bursts, macro-oscillator, granular and texture voices (Mutable Instruments open-source DSP), a pin matrix and the REEL

modules.name: FLOATDAT
modules.description: CELLULA x FLOATER x VORTESSA x DATUM played by a Markov pinball sequencer; any file is the material, drawn as datamatic scenes

modules.name: SPLICEBUS
modules.description: FLOATER's REEL as a bus effect: splices and genes on the clock, ORDER <> CHAOS over a split that keeps the bass whole, TURNAROUND's phrase form

modules.name: CELLULA
modules.description: Nine 64-cell automata as rhythm, wavetable and FFT mask; sine/click datamatics voice with bit-matrix and barcode screens

modules.name: DATUM
modules.description: A metro writes random (or any file's) data into three 512-sample buffers read as sound; LCD digit field, buffer barcodes, gate outs

modules.name: PALIMPSEST
modules.description: Text as a 64 x 32 bit field read by 32 sines, a cellular-automaton cursor rewriting it as it plays; field and rule screens

modules.name: PINDATA
modules.description: CELLULA x PALIMPSEST x DATUM played by a Markov pinball sequencer, fed by any file; datamatic scenes, lane gate/pitch/velocity outs, BUS

modules.name: IKEDAT
modules.description: CELLULA x DATUM x a Markov pinball: a datamatic instrument fed by any file, live datamatics visuals as the UI, lane gate/pitch/velocity outs, BUS

modules.name: DATASCREEN
modules.description: The family's visual hub: one big screen rendering 26 datamatic scenes (PINDATA, FLOATDAT films, case/reel/orbit/attractor/vortex/ghost) from audio, lane/step events, the BUS cable and any file

modules.name: BREAKDNA
modules.description: Groove-DNA transfer and A/B spectral cross-synthesis of two breaks, clocked

modules.name: GENOTYPE
modules.description: Break-learned Pinball Markov walk: the walk a break wants, learned from its DNA

modules.name: LOOPGENOME
modules.description: Drums and neuro bass learned as one loop; one Pinball ball picks the drum slice and the bass articulation

modules.name: BREAKMED
modules.description: Generative tracker jungle break slicer: weighted chains (pitch, sub, glitch, reverse, drill), Paula sampler, hit log

modules.name: BREAKSLICER
modules.description: Generative tracker break slicer: onset analysis, Markov pattern with 09xx / Rxy / drills, routing matrix, S950 / S1000 / Paula samplers

modules.name: BREAKBEAT
modules.description: schwung-breakbeat slicer with BBCut cut procedures (CutProc11, WarpCut, SQPusher1, ChooseCut), loop A/B phrase, retriggers, cut display

modules.name: NEUROSTACK
modules.description: Neuro bass voice: eight layers on one phase switched by the Pinball Markov walk, a 32-step rhythm, pitch-tracked split over one clean sub

modules.name: SNARESTACK
modules.description: Four snare layers (built-in or WAV) aligned in time and phase into one hit, re-weighted as crack / body / tail

modules.name: SUBSTRATE
modules.description: Automatic DnB low end: pitch-tracked mono split, a rebuilt phase-continuous sub, edit repair; low-end map and phase scope

modules.name: DROP II
modules.description: Drop-2 switch-up generator for DnB: from drop-1 drums + bass and IDENTITY it writes drop 2 (half-time, kick shift, bass lock, flip, call/response)

modules.name: CALL & RESPONSE
modules.description: Call and response phrase generator (Side Brain C&R Generator / Nordl3, MIT): two mono voices as V/OCT, gate and velocity

modules.name: ACID
modules.description: TB-3PO x 303: generative acid line (Phazerville TB-3PO) and its 303 voice (schwung-303 / Open303), with the line as V/OCT, gate, accent and slide

modules.name: QUANTA
modules.description: Microsound particle synth after Curtis Roads (grain, glisson, grainlet, trainlet, pulsar) with an arrangement generator after Ryoji Ikeda's structures

modules.name: ILLUSORIUM
modules.description: 26 psychoacoustic illusions as one stereo effect (Shepard, Risset, Deutsch, Huggins, Zwicker, Warren, Bregman, Haas, Franssen and more), one at a time

modules.name: TYMPAN
modules.description: Percussion voice: two oscillators, noise, a Sallen & Key filter, three envelopes and four 8-step rows (PITCH, VEL, MOD 1, MOD 2)

modules.name: MANIFOLD
modules.description: Generative modular instrument: factory patches of generators and FX on 8 channel lanes, 24 macros, patterns, WANDER, CHAOS

modules.name: MODPORT
modules.description: ProTracker .mod player (1-8 channels, pt2-clone replayer): one row per clock or free tempo, per-channel gate and V/OCT, Amiga stereo mix

modules.name: DUBPLATE
modules.description: Genre arrangement builder (jungle, DnB, UK garage, speed garage): template sections and role lanes as gates, fills, variations, FX events, FamilyBus

modules.name: CONDUIT
modules.description: Family patch bay: BUS + trigger / CV rows into a pin matrix (amount, curve, delay, probability, length) driving 8 CV / trigger / gate outputs

modules.name: BLACKBOX
modules.description: Family flight recorder: records the BUS and 4 CV + 4 gate lanes into a ring buffer, replay / recall from a cursor, MIDI file export

modules.name: SETBOOK
modules.description: Family scene memory: 8 scenes x 8 CV channels with timed morph, curves, X/Y pad, BUS scene / EPOCH cues; in Rack also morphs every SEMI module's knobs
